mice.f1_desc: End-to-end logistics for corporate events of any scale.

mice.approach_body: We coordinate every logistical detail — venues, transport, activities, and production — so your congress, convention, or incentive trip runs flawlessly and your team experiences Guatemala.

agencias.f1_desc: Your on-the-ground partner in Guatemala, with guaranteed quality.
agencias.f2_desc: Competitive net rates so you can build and sell your packages.
agencias.f3_desc: A team that responds fast and solves on the ground.
agencias.f4_desc: Hotels, restaurants, airlines, and the country's water transport.
agencias.approach_body: We back your agency with net rates, real availability, and a local team that responds fast. Sell Guatemala with the confidence of a reliable partner.
